questions.stem:
—Can I watch TV now, Mom?
—Yes, you can. But you must finish your homework first.
—Don't worry. I _____ it already.
questions.explanation: 本题考查现在完成时与一般过去时的区别。答句中的"already"（已经）是现在完成时的标志词，强调过去完成的动作对现在造成的影响（作业已经完成了，所以现在可以看电视）。A选项finished是一般过去时，仅表示过去发生的动作，不强调对现在的影响；C选项finish是一般现在时，不符合语境；D选项had finished是过去完成时，表示"过去的过去"，此处没有对比的过去时间点，因此不选。解题技巧：看到already/yet/just等标志词，优先考虑现在完成时。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The girl _____ won the first prize is my best friend. She practiced very hard for the competition.
questions.explanation: 本题考查定语从句关系代词的选择。先行词"The girl"指人，且在定语从句"_____ won the first prize"中作主语，因此应使用关系代词who。B选项which用于指物；C选项whom虽然指人，但只能作宾语；D选项whose表示"...的"，在从句中作定语，后需接名词。解题技巧：指人用who/whom/that，指物用which/that；从句缺主语用who/which，缺宾语用whom/which/who。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The new library _____ last month. It will open to the students next week.
questions.explanation: 本题考查被动语态。主语"The new library"（新图书馆）是动作"建造"的承受者，因此需用被动语态，结构为"be + 过去分词"。时间状语"last month"（上个月）表明是一般过去时，因此用was built。A选项builds是主动语态一般现在时；B选项built是主动语态一般过去时；D选项is built是一般现在时被动，时态不符。解题技巧：找主语和动词的关系，是"被做"就用被动；再看时间状语确定时态。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—_____ it be true that our school will have a three-day holiday next week?
—It _____ be true. The headmaster has just confirmed it in the meeting.
questions.explanation: 本题考查情态动词表推测的用法。第一空在疑问句中表示"可能"，用Can，Must只能用于肯定句表推测；第二空根据"校长刚刚在会议上确认了"可知是肯定推测，用must表示"一定"。can't表示否定推测"不可能"，不符合语境。解题技巧：表推测时，肯定句用must（一定）/may（可能）/can't（不可能）；疑问句和否定句用can；mustn't表示"禁止"，不表推测。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: We should _____ our old books to the children in poor areas instead of throwing them away.
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析。give away表示"捐赠、赠送"；give up表示"放弃"；give in表示"屈服、让步"；give out表示"分发、耗尽"。根据语境"给贫困地区的孩子"和"而不是扔掉"，应选"捐赠"。解题技巧：记住give相关短语的核心含义，away（离开/送走）、up（向上/放弃）、in（向内/屈服）、out（向外/分发）。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: The news that our team won the game was really _____. Everyone cheered loudly.
questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换及-ing/-ed形容词区别。修饰"news"（消息）要用-ing结尾的形容词exciting（令人兴奋的），表示事物本身的性质；excited（感到兴奋的）用于修饰人，表示人的感受；excite是动词；excitement是名词。解题技巧：-ing形容词修饰"物"，-ed形容词修饰"人"；口诀："令人-ing，感到-ed"。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: The weather was extremely hot, so the ice cream in my hand began to melt quickly. The word "melt" means _____.
questions.explanation: 本题考查通过上下文猜测词义。根据前文"天气极热"和后文"冰淇淋"可推断，热天冰淇淋会"融化"。A、C、D选项都是与"热"相反的结果。解题技巧：猜词题要关注因果、转折、并列等逻辑关系，以及同义/反义提示；本题为因果逻辑（热→融化）。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.group_passage:
Last week, our school held an activity called "Green Week". The purpose was to help students understand the importance of protecting the environment.

During the week, we did many meaningful things. On Monday, our teacher asked us to (8)_____ a poster about saving water. My classmates and I worked together. We drew pictures and wrote some useful tips on it.

On Wednesday, we went to a nearby park to pick up rubbish. At first, some students thought it was (9)_____ and didn't want to do it. But when they saw how dirty the park was, they changed their minds. We collected three big bags of rubbish in total.

The most interesting part was on Friday. We (10)_____ old items like bottles and paper to make beautiful art works. I made a pen holder with a plastic bottle. It looked great on my desk.

Through this activity, I realized that protecting the environment isn't just something for scientists. Everyone can do their part. Even small actions can make a big (11)_____. I hope more students will join us and care about the world we live (12)_____.
questions.explanation: 本题考查语境推理。根据下文"We drew pictures and wrote some useful tips on it"（我们在上面画画并写上提示）可知，老师让我们"制作"海报，make符合语境。buy（买）、borrow（借）、receive（收到）均与后文"自己动手做"的描述不符。解题技巧：完形填空要关注上下文动作的逻辑链，后文具体描述制作过程的细节是前文的提示。

questions.group_passage:
Do you know that bananas can help you sleep better? Many people have trouble falling asleep at night. They often feel tired during the day because they don't get enough rest. Some people take medicine to help them sleep, but that can be expensive and sometimes unhealthy. Scientists have found a simple, natural way to solve this problem, and it is probably already in your kitchen.

Bananas contain a kind of chemical called tryptophan (色氨酸). This special chemical helps your body produce melatonin (褪黑素), which controls your sleep cycle naturally. When you eat a banana about one hour before bed, the tryptophan slowly enters your body and helps your muscles relax. Your mind becomes calmer, making it easier to fall asleep.

However, eating too many bananas is not good. One medium banana is enough for most people. Also, timing is important. You should eat it about one hour before you plan to sleep. If you eat it right before lying down, your stomach might feel uncomfortable because it is still working to digest (消化) the food.

Besides helping with sleep, bananas offer other health benefits. They are rich in potassium (钾), which is good for your heart and muscles. Many students in our school have tried this method. Tom, a 14-year-old boy, said, "I used to stay awake until midnight. But after eating a banana before bed for a week, I can fall asleep much faster now." Next time you find yourself counting sheep at midnight, try reaching for a banana instead!
questions.stem: According to the passage, which chemical in bananas helps with sleep?
questions.explanation: 本题为细节理解题。根据第二段第一句"Bananas contain a kind of chemical called tryptophan"和第二句"This special chemical helps your body produce melatonin"可知，香蕉中含有的是tryptophan（色氨酸），它帮助身体产生melatonin（褪黑素）。因此直接帮助睡眠的化学物质是tryptophan。A选项Melatonin是身体产生的，不是香蕉直接含有的；B选项Potassium是钾，对心脏和肌肉有益，但与睡眠无直接关系；D选项Protein文章未提及。解题技巧：细节题要准确定位原文，注意区分"含有"和"产生"的逻辑关系。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解

questions.stem: What can we infer from Tom's words in the last paragraph?
options: A. Tom doesn't like the taste of bananas.
B. Tom had sleep problems before trying this method.
C. Tom prefers taking medicine to eating bananas.
D. Tom thinks bananas are too expensive.
questions.explanation: 本题为推理判断题。根据Tom所说"I used to stay awake until midnight"（我过去常常熬到半夜）和"I can fall asleep much faster now"（现在能更快入睡）可推断，Tom以前有睡眠问题。A选项说Tom不喜欢香蕉味道，与原文积极评价相反；C选项说他更喜欢吃药，文中未提及比较；D选项说香蕉太贵，与第一段"expensive"形容药物而非香蕉矛盾。解题技巧：推理题要基于原文信息进行合理推断，不能过度推断或加入个人想象；关注引语中的对比（used to vs now）。
questions.label: 阅读-推理判断

options: B. How to Grow Banana Trees
C. Bananas: A Natural Sleep Aid
D. Healthy Eating Habits for Students
questions.explanation: 本题考查主旨大意/最佳标题。文章首段提出香蕉能帮助睡眠，第二段解释科学原理（色氨酸和褪黑素），第三段讲食用注意事项，第四段补充其他益处并举例。全文核心是香蕉作为天然助眠食物。A选项"香蕉的历史"、B选项"如何种植香蕉树"文中未提及；D选项"学生健康饮食习惯"过于宽泛，未突出"睡眠"这一核心。解题技巧：最佳标题要涵盖文章核心话题（bananas + sleep），不能过大或过小；关注首尾段主题句。

questions.group_passage:
Students often feel stressed because of too much homework. Here are some ways to balance study and relaxation.

First, make a plan. (17)_____ Write down what you need to do and how long it will take. This helps you manage your time better.

Second, take breaks. Studying for hours without resting makes you tired. (18)_____ You can listen to music or do some exercise during the break.

Third, don't forget your hobbies. (19)_____ If you like painting, spend some time on it on weekends. This makes you happy and helps you study better later.

(20)_____ If you follow these suggestions, you will find that studying can be enjoyable and relaxing.
options: A. For example, study for 45 minutes and then rest for 10 minutes.
B. In this way, you won't forget important tasks.
C. They bring you pleasure and help reduce stress.
D. However, don't spend too much time on them.
E. I hope these tips work well for you.
questions.explanation: 本题考查段落衔接与逻辑关系。前句说"首先，制定计划"，后句说"写下需要做什么..."，中间B选项"In this way, you won't forget important tasks"（这样你就不会忘记重要任务）起到承上启下作用，"this way"指代"make a plan"，解释为什么要制定计划。A选项是举例，但后文已有"write down..."的具体动作，不需要再举例；C、D、E与"制定计划"主题无关。解题技巧：关注代词指代（this way）和逻辑衔接（因果）。
questions.label: 短文填空

questions.group_passage:
Students often feel stressed because of too much homework. Here are some ways to balance study and relaxation.

First, make a plan. (17)_____ Write down what you need to do and how long it will take. This helps you manage your time better.

Second, take breaks. Studying for hours without resting makes you tired. (18)_____ You can listen to music or do some exercise during the break.

Third, don't forget your hobbies. (19)_____ If you like painting, spend some time on it on weekends. This makes you happy and helps you study better later.

(20)_____ If you follow these suggestions, you will find that studying can be enjoyable and relaxing.
options: A. For example, study for 45 minutes and then rest for 10 minutes.
B. In this way, you won't forget important tasks.
C. They bring you pleasure and help reduce stress.
D. However, don't spend too much time on them.
E. I hope these tips work well for you.
questions.explanation: 本题考查段落衔接与文章结构。此处位于文章最后一段开头，后文"If you follow these suggestions..."是总结性语句，E选项"I hope these tips work well for you"（希望这些建议对你有用）作为总结过渡句最合适，引出最终祝愿。A、B、C已用；D选项"However"表示转折，但此处与前文并非转折关系，且"them"指代不明。解题技巧：识别文章结构（总分总），最后一段通常用总结性语言（I hope/In conclusion/Finally）。
questions.label: 短文填空
